message.content:
In December, Los Angeles enjoys a mild winter. Typical averages are:

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| **Average high** | ~18 °C (≈64 °F) |
| **Average low** | ~10 °C (≈50 °F) |
| **Mean daily temperature** | ~14 °C (≈57 °F) |

So you can expect daytime temperatures in the mid‑60s °F (around 18 °C) and nighttime lows in the low 50s °F (about 10 °C). The weather is generally sunny and dry, with occasional cooler fronts that can bring a few days of cooler, breezy conditions.
